title: Pause + movement in same tick still moves the player
observed: Running `pause+right` from a fresh seed 1 game pauses the game but the player moves from (1,1) to (2,1).
expected: Pause takes effect immediately after being read, so the right movement key should be ignored; the player should stay at (1,1) and no other effects should occur that tick.

title: Multiple movement keys in same tick all execute
observed: Running `right+up` from (1,1) moves the player to (2,1), even though the last movement key is `up`. which is blocked by the wall at (1,0).
expected: Only the last movement key in a tick should count; `up` is blocked, so the player should bump and remain at (1,1).

title: Key collected in same tick as enemy hit is lost on respawn
observed: The player picks up the key at (4,5) on the same tick an enemy hit occurs; after respawn the HUD Keys value is 0 instead of 1.
expected: The player should keep all items collected in the same tick they lose a life, including the key, so HUD Keys should show 1 after respawn.
